root_causes.description: recommendation service experiencing extreme CPU usage (z=+810.80) and memory usage (z=>1000) above pre-incident baselines, indicating resource exhaustion as the root cause. No error traces, logs, or pod restarts observed, confirming the fault is resource stress rather than crashes or dependency failures.

evidence.expected_baseline: error traces should be absent if fault is resource stress only
no error logs expected for resource-stress-only fault
no pod restarts or kill events for resource-stress-only fault

remediation_steps: Increase CPU and memory limits for the recommendation Deployment/StatefulSet
Investigate for memory leaks or runaway processes in the recommendation service code
Add horizontal scaling (HPA) for recommendation if load increases
Monitor resource quotas and limit ranges in the otel-demo namespace
